scope: Independent synthetic calculations only. No production data or pipeline code executed.
historical_fit_nonnegative_proof: For n>=1, 0<w<1. With y in [0,1] and its w-weighted mean mu, weighted variance <= mu*(1-mu). Thus v=(sum(w)/M)*weighted_variance < mu*(1-mu) for an interior mean and positive variance; finite kappa is strictly positive. Zero variance and boundary means need explicit handling. A negative result indicates invalid inputs/numerics or a different formula, not legitimate high dispersion under these assumptions.

duplicating_within_variant_counts.conclusion: Doubling both counts within units leaves mu fixed here but decreases kappa; Claude proposed the wrong required direction.

geometry_only_weight_test: Changing affected/unaffected counts while fixing geometry and eligible unit IDs must leave W unchanged; the posterior labels and D may change.
same_residue_weight_test: d=0 implies raw K=1, not normalized W=1 unless no other positive-weight eligible donor exists.
